name: text-anchor-doc
title: Text Anchor Doc
description: The bridge between a ProseMirror document and comment-anchor offsets — anchorText (blocks joined by a newline, a mention as @label, other leaves as ￼), textIndex, and the exact two-way offsetsToRange / rangeToOffsets map.

meta.whenToUse: Mapping comment anchors onto a TextEdit (Tiptap/ProseMirror) document and back.
meta.whenNotToUse: Server code with no ProseMirror document — use text-anchor on the flat text.
